title: Saikosaponin D Mitigates Radioresistance in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer by Inducing MRE11 De-Lactylation via HIF1alpha/HDAC5 Pathway.
authors: Li, Jingyi; Feng, Liang; Zhang, Lei; Zhang, Weiguo; Zhang, Yanting; Liu, Xiaoqin; Cai, Qianqian; Zhao, Weiming; Huang, Gang; Lu, Changlian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究乳腺癌放疗抵抗中MRE11乳酸化修饰及药物机制，虽涉及HADDOCK蛋白-蛋白对接和ChIP-qPCR的蛋白-DNA结合，但核心是蛋白修饰与信号通路，非TF-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅边缘使用。
abstract: Background: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), the most aggressive breast cancer subtype, exhibits poor prognosis due to radiotherapy resistance. However, the underlying mechanisms and effective therapeutic agents remain elusive. Methods: We employed lactate/oxamate to assess DNA damage/repair in irradiated TNBC cell lines. Lentiviral vectors for MRE11/HDAC5 constructs and shRNA were used to explore lactylation via Western blot/Co-IP. TCGA data mining, tissue microarrays, proteomics-MS, and gene expression profiling were used to dissect Saikosaponin D (SSD)'s radiosensitizing mechanisms. Promoter luciferase assays and ChIP-qPCR were performed to map SSD-induced HIF1alpha binding sites on the HDAC5 promoter. Results: Elevated endogenous lactate in radioresistant TNBC cells promoted DNA repair via MRE11 Lys(673) lactylation, a critical modification conferring radioresistance. HDAC5 was identified as the key delactylase for MRE11 Lys(673,) validated by HADDOCK docking (hydrogen bond between MRE11 Lys(673) and HDAC5 Ser(18)) and Co-IP (HDAC5 overexpression reduced K(673) lactylation). TCGA and clinical tissue microarrays confirmed HDAC5 downregulation in TNBC. SSD inhibits the malignant phenotype of TNBC and enhances radiotherapy efficacy by inhibition on MRE11 lactylation via upregulating HDAC5. Mechanistically, SSD upregulated HIF1alpha to bind the HDAC5 promoter (-342bp to -20bp region) to activate its expression. Conclusion: Lactate-driven MRE11 Lys(673) lactylation mediates radioresistance, while SSD reverses this via HIF1alpha/HDAC5 axis activation. Our findings identify SSD as a radiosensitizer and HDAC5/MRE11 as potential therapeutic targets for TNBC.
abstract_zh: 背景：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是最具侵袭性的乳腺癌亚型，由于放疗抵抗而预后不良。然而，其潜在机制和有效治疗药物仍不明确。方法：我们采用乳酸/草氨酸评估照射后TNBC细胞系中的DNA损伤/修复。使用MRE11/HDAC5构建体和shRNA的慢病毒载体，通过Western blot/Co-IP探讨乳酸化修饰。利用TCGA数据挖掘、组织微阵列、蛋白质组学-质谱和基因表达谱分析，解析柴胡皂苷D（SSD）的放射增敏机制。通过启动子荧光素酶实验和ChIP-qPCR，定位SSD诱导的HIF1alpha在HDAC5启动子上的结合位点。结果：放射抵抗性TNBC细胞中升高的内源性乳酸通过MRE11 Lys(673)乳酸化促进DNA修复，这是赋予放射抵抗的关键修饰。HDAC5被鉴定为MRE11 Lys(673)的关键去乳酸化酶，并通过HADDOCK对接（MRE11 Lys(673)与HDAC5 Ser(18)之间的氢键）和Co-IP（HDAC5过表达降低K(673)乳酸化）验证。TCGA和临床组织微阵列证实HDAC5在TNBC中下调。SSD通过上调HDAC5抑制MRE11乳酸化，从而抑制TNBC恶性表型并增强放疗疗效。机制上，SSD上调HIF1alpha以结合HDAC5启动子（-342bp至-20bp区域）激活其表达。结论：乳酸驱动的MRE11 Lys(673)乳酸化介导放射抵抗，而SSD通过激活HIF1alpha/HDAC5轴逆转此过程。我们的发现将SSD鉴定为放射增敏剂，并将HDAC5/MRE11作为TNBC的潜在治疗靶点。
